name: Balanced score of retrieval on file, topic, orientation and no-context requests, with the index size
purpose: An arm is judged by one number: whether the files a request needs are among the units shown within a fixed token budget, in the right order, without noise tokens, and nothing is shown when nothing is needed, at an index size, price and time a consumer would pay.
record: Per arm, the balanced score (accuracy, cost and time; [balance.context_retrieval]), one number per arm per stage. The case set mixes four kinds with the weights of evaluation/context_retrieval/mix.py over the pinned Quest AI Runner and hub corpus: file-finding tasks, topic tasks taken from the git history (the files a commit changed are the needed ones; any learning uses only older commits), orientation (a file of the target's folder among the first three) and requests that need no context. Labels are graded (needed, helpful, irrelevant); a case's utility is 0.60 recall of the needed files within 4000 tokens, 0.25 nDCG@10 and 0.15 times one minus the noise share of the tokens shown; an index larger than the corpus gives up that share of every case. In the details: each kind's mean utility and counted cases, recall, nDCG, noise, units, index size and build seconds.
disadvantages: One Python repository and its commit subjects, not prose folders or conversations; the mix is set by value and a sample of real requests should calibrate it; files stand for relevance, so a needed passage inside a needed file is not told from the rest of it; the library's accuracy is a pass count, so fractional utility enters as a pass when it is above a fixed place per case (its expectation is the mean utility); a cold dense build is minutes and is not in the seconds per request.
cascading_conditionals: idea [kind=idea | scale=esoi/idea-rating-scale.md | min-pass-rate=0.75 | when=a new alternative is described: rate it on the five questions of the scale before it is built] > free [sample=full | real=no | gate=competitive | when=the arms that call no model rank every request of the mix: seconds once the vectors are cached, and the stage to iterate in] > model [sample=full | real=yes | when=a model reranker beat the best free arm on the free stage: its calls are recorded to a cassette and replayed, paid only for the first full recording]
